claims.statement: The EU Data Act has applied since 12 September 2025 and gives consumers and business users access to and the ability to share raw data generated by connected devices.
The Commission explicitly links connected-device data access to third-party repair and after-sales services, making an entitlement and export event operationally concrete.

contrary_evidence: Large IoT clouds and OEMs can build native portals; actual request volume may be low and the Data Act also protects trade secrets and security.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: cross-OEM library of device schemas, identity proofs and adjudicated request patterns
fingerprint.customer: small and mid-sized connected-product OEMs lacking a user-data access operation
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: IoT cloud platforms, warranty administrators and equipment service networks
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: white-label request portal, identity graph, policy engine and scoped data export
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: OEM pays per deployed device and completed entitlement decision or data stream
fingerprint.problem_trigger: a device user or authorised third party requests raw connected-product data

founder_fit: Strong privacy-aware data-platform fit and a renewable-equipment beachhead through the family network. UNVALIDATED HYPOTHESIS: PLN 70000 funds a one-OEM, one-device-family pilot.
risks: An entitlement error can leak personal or industrial data.
OEM contracts may not grant the access needed for a processor role.

structure.control_point: identity and entitlement decision before connected-product data export
structure.critical_dependency: contractual telemetry access and reliable device-to-user identity mapping

thesis: Operate an OEM-branded gateway that authenticates users of connected heat pumps, machinery or wearables, maps device ownership to data rights and streams only entitled telemetry to the user or chosen service provider. A reusable device-schema and adjudicated entitlement library lets smaller OEMs comply without exposing trade secrets or building a full access operation.
title: Connected-Equipment Data Entitlement Gateway
uncertainties: Which vertical has enough request volume
Cloud egress economics and OEM procurement time
